name: Futanari Kanojo Kyousei Seikatsu ~Atashi no Milk, Anata ni Shiboritotte Hoshii!~
original_name: フタナリ彼女矯正生活 ～あたしのミルク、アナタに絞りとって欲しいっ～
source:
Five years have passed after the events of [url=/v7331]Doukyuusei Kaizou ~Namaiki Musume wa Jikkendai ni Shiteshimae!~[/url] when the protagonist successfully ostracized a girl he disliked who kept picking fights with him by "transforming her into a futanari" with his new drug and effectively silencing her socially. 

The two are now living together. 

The reasons of why are simple: they realized they were mutually in love and the protagonist also feels a deep sense of guilt for what he did and he still hadn't been able to return Miki's body to normal.

As a futanari, her libido would run wild at the slightest provocation, making it impossible for her to live a normal life.

Then, one day, the protagonist's research takes a step forward and it marks the beginning of a "special training" to restore Miki's body to normal and help her reintegrate into society.

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ011875.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
在[url=/v7331]《同级生改造～把嚣张女孩变成实验对象！～》[/url]的事件过去五年后，主人公成功用新药把一直找他麻烦、令他讨厌的女孩“变成扶她”，有效地让她在社会上失去立足之地。

如今，两人住在一起。

原因很简单：他们发现彼此相爱；主人公也对自己的行为深感愧疚，却始终没能让美树的身体恢复正常。

作为扶她，她的性欲会在最轻微的刺激下失控，让她无法过普通生活。

某天，主人公的研究取得进展，这标志着“特殊训练”的开始：恢复美树的身体，让她重新融入社会。
